root_dir.description: Absolute path to the Firebird installation directory (contains bin/, system/DBs, etc.).

tcpip_port.description: TCP port for client connections. Standard Firebird port is 3050.

tcpip_bind_address.description: IP address(es) the server listens on. Use 'localhost', '0.0.0.0' (all), or specific IPs (comma-separated).

max_connect_count.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed. Increase for high-traffic apps.

security_database_path.description: Path to the security database (gsec-managed users). Usually security2.fdb inside the root dir.

default_database_path.description: Default directory where database files are stored if no full path is given in SQL.

log_filename.description: Path to the main server log file. Use empty string '' or 'none' to disable.

log_max_size.description: Max log file size (MB) before rotation. Set 0 to disable rotation.

trace_sql.description: Enable SQL tracing (detailed query logs). Only for debugging — not for production.

trace_filename.description: Path for authentication/SQL trace logs (if enabled).

default_db_cache_pages.description: Default number of cache pages (≈ 8 KB each) per database. Larger caches improve performance.

temp_cache_limit.description: Max temp memory (KB) per transaction for sorting/joins. Increase for complex OLAP queries.

transaction_memory_limit.description: Max memory (MB) per transaction. Adjust for large multi-statement transactions.

lock_hash_slots.description: Hash table size for lock management. Must be power of 2; larger values reduce contention.

shadow_path.description: Directory for auto-created shadow database files. Shadows provide crash redundancy.

remote_access.description: Allow remote (network) client connections. Disable for local-only use.

user_password_policy.description: Enforce password policy (min length, complexity) for new/changed users.

idle_connection_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-closing idle connections (0 = no timeout).

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for SuperServer mode. Increase under high concurrency.

query_timeout.description: Max query execution time (ms). 0 = no timeout (use with caution).

max_open_files.description: Max open file descriptors. Ensure system limits (ulimit) support this value.

items.description: Search path(s) for alias definition files. Ordered priority.

alias_resolution.description: List of paths where Firebird looks for .conf files defining database aliases (e.g., alias.conf).
